title: LabAlignAgent: A LOINC-Enriched Ontology-Guided Agent for Cross-Hospital Semantic Alignment of EMR Laboratory Tests

live_model.evidence: Table 2: "Model for pairwise comparison GPT-4 (gpt-4-0613); Model for LOINC batch prompting GPT-4 Turbo (gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09); Temperature 0.0"; Sec. 6.3: pairs "were submitted to GPT-4 Turbo using batch processing".

prompt.location: Listing 2 (dynamic prompt template for LOINC enrichment, Sec. 4)
prompt.note: Template with metadata slots; the pairwise-comparison prompt is described, not printed.

claim.metric: count of LLM-resolved LOINC matches (not an accuracy)
claim.location: Table 3, column GPT (KFSH 10, SGH 57 of 262 tests); expert validation: 94/100 sampled LOINC assignments correct (Sec. 6.2)

data.source: https://github.com/SarahayadAOU/LabAlignAgent (lab test lists for KFSH and SGH, ontologies, alignment results)

notes: No self-contained model metric: the 67 matches are what the LLM stage produced after exact and fuzzy matching consumed the rest of the pipeline, and the 94% precision is an expert review of an unidentified random sample.
